labyrinth = [data[2+i] for i in range(n)]

MOD = 10**9 + 7

dp = [[0] * m for _ in range(n)]
dp[0][0] = 1

    for j in range(m):

            dp[i][j] = (dp[i][j] + dp[i][j-1]) % MOD

print(dp[n-1][m-1])
